exportError.encoderStall: The video encoder stopped responding, so the export was stopped. Try again; if it keeps happening, close other apps that use the graphics card.
exportError.encoderFlushTimeout: The video encoder did not finish writing the last frames in time. Try exporting again.
exportError.encoderUnsupported: No video encoder on this system supports the chosen export settings. Try a lower resolution or frame rate.
exportError.encoderFailed: The video encoder reported an error and the export was stopped. Try again, or export at a lower resolution.
exportError.decoderFailed: The recording could not be decoded, so the export was stopped. The file may be damaged or use an unsupported codec.

tutorial.title: How Trimming Works
tutorial.desc: Understanding how to cut out unwanted parts of your video.
tutorial.explain: The Trim tool works by defining the segments you want to remove. Any part covered by a red trim segment will be cut out when you export.
tutorial.step1desc: Press T or click the scissors icon to mark a section for removal.
tutorial.step2desc: Drag the edges of the red region to cover exactly what you want to cut out.
